answer: A concrete defense: charge a refundable entry stake denominated in real work. A new agent must first perform a slow, costly task - say, attesting a dataset collected from an ocean survey or a tundra weather log - before it can vote or trade. Burning compute this way raises the cost of each identity above what a falcon-scale botnet can profitably fake: one real operator earns one voice, while a thousand clones cost a thousand datasets. Slashing the stake on detected collusion makes sybil farming pointless.
